description: Cross-layer sovereign boot, update, operations, evidence, and recovery adversarial scenario corpus. This file defines test intent; it is not execution evidence.

scenarios.fault_injection: Renderer executable is missing, disabled, or exits before it opens DRM.
scenarios.expected_state: Host boot and recovery remain reachable; renderer availability is non-authoritative.
forbidden_outcomes: Boot or recovery target depends on the renderer.
The renderer's absence is reported as a security failure of the host.

scenarios.fault_injection: Renderer crashes or ignores the handoff stop request.
scenarios.expected_state: Display-manager handoff completes or falls back safely; recovery remains available.
forbidden_outcomes: Login/recovery blocked indefinitely.
DRM ownership reported released without observation.
scenarios.target: Existing issue #9 proposes QEMU p95 DRM-release latency <= 750 ms; physical results must be separate.

scenarios.fault_injection: Reduced-motion mode starts at different elapsed times or receives changing simulation time.
scenarios.expected_state: Reduced mode immediately produces deterministic still output for the same inputs.
forbidden_outcomes: Animation begins before static frame availability.
Elapsed-time changes alter Reduced-mode pixels.

scenarios.fault_injection: Renderer attempts unsupported or unexpected network activity.
scenarios.expected_state: Boot renderer has no IP-network dependency or remote-asset requirement.
forbidden_outcomes: Renderer network access becomes necessary for boot/recovery.
Unexpected IP socket activity is hidden from the receipt.

scenarios.fault_injection: An operational intent has no valid explicit operator-authorization receipt or references another target/generation.
scenarios.expected_state: Intent remains a proposal; no host mutation is authorized.
forbidden_outcomes: Missing approval interpreted as approval.
Target or generation mismatch is ignored.

scenarios.fault_injection: Proof generation or threshold signing is unavailable.
scenarios.expected_state: The operation returns an explicit unavailable/error state or an explicitly unsigned observation.
forbidden_outcomes: Placeholder bytes or a fixed digest are labelled proof.
Unsigned pulses are labelled authenticated.

scenarios.fault_injection: Downloaded or staged artifact bytes do not match the digest in authorized metadata.
scenarios.expected_state: Artifact is rejected before activation; current known-good state remains addressable.
forbidden_outcomes: Artifact is activated after digest mismatch.
A transport success substitutes for artifact verification.

scenarios.fault_injection: An update offers a generation older than the locally recorded trusted generation.
scenarios.expected_state: Rollback is rejected unless a separate explicit recovery authorization path permits it and records the reason.
forbidden_outcomes: Silent downgrade.
A numeric generation alone is treated as a signed authorization.

scenarios.fault_injection: Update metadata is expired, frozen, fast-forwarded, or mixed across inconsistent snapshots.
scenarios.expected_state: Update promotion stops and the specific metadata failure is observable.
forbidden_outcomes: Expired metadata accepted as current.
Mixed metadata accepted as one release.
Missing metadata reported as verified success.

scenarios.fault_injection: Power loss or process termination occurs at each activation transaction boundary.
scenarios.expected_state: After restart, the system selects either the prior complete generation or the new complete generation.
forbidden_outcomes: Hybrid generation treated as valid.
Partially written state reported as committed.
Rollback target disappears before new generation is usable.

scenarios.fault_injection: A stale, expired, replayed, or wrong-target challenge-bound receipt is submitted for promotion.
scenarios.expected_state: Receipt is rejected and promotion is denied.
forbidden_outcomes: Replay accepted.
Expired challenge accepted.
Receipt from a different target, policy digest, or generation accepted.

scenarios.fault_injection: Verifier process restarts after a challenge nonce has been consumed.
scenarios.expected_state: Durably consumed challenge cannot be replayed after restart.
forbidden_outcomes: In-memory-only replay guard described as restart-safe.
Nonce state lost while associated promotion remains committed.

scenarios.fault_injection: Multiple workers concurrently attempt to consume the same challenge and promote the same target.
scenarios.expected_state: Exactly one transaction succeeds; challenge consumption and promotion decision are atomic.
forbidden_outcomes: Two successful promotions consume the same challenge.
Nonce consumed without a committed decision, or decision committed without nonce consumption.

scenarios.fault_injection: Receipt JSON is semantically reserialized or one byte is changed after its digest envelope is created.
scenarios.expected_state: Exact-byte digest mismatch is rejected.
forbidden_outcomes: Parsed-object equivalence silently substitutes for exact-byte binding.
Hash consistency is misrepresented as signer or device authentication.

scenarios.fault_injection: Network is unavailable but a locally stored known-good artifact and its trust metadata remain valid.
scenarios.expected_state: Recovery uses only verified local inputs and records offline mode.
forbidden_outcomes: Recovery silently downloads remote code.
Offline capability is claimed without proving the local artifact's authorization.

scenarios.fault_injection: Network is unavailable and no authorized recovery artifact can be verified.
scenarios.expected_state: System enters an explicit degraded/maintenance state without activating unverified code.
forbidden_outcomes: Unverified artifact activated to improve availability.
Unknown recovery state presented as successful recovery.

scenarios.fault_injection: Lifecycle receipt is missing, malformed, truncated, or has an invalid digest.
scenarios.expected_state: Receipt is treated as untrusted; evidence is reconstructed or the system reports not qualified.
forbidden_outcomes: Missing evidence becomes a default PASS.
Malformed receipt partially authorizes a transition.

scenarios.fault_injection: Receipt clock moves backward, disagrees with verifier time, or provides only self-asserted timestamps.
scenarios.expected_state: Freshness is not established without the verifier's permitted time source and valid bounds.
forbidden_outcomes: Receipt timestamp used as the sole current-time authority.
Clock uncertainty collapsed into verified currentness.

scenarios.fault_injection: Some targets are unreachable or fail verification while other targets succeed.
scenarios.expected_state: Per-target statuses and partial progress are preserved; aggregate status reflects every in-scope target.
forbidden_outcomes: One success masks another target's failure.
Unreachable target is counted as compliant.
Retry overwrites the original failure evidence.

scenarios.fault_injection: Required qualification lane is queued, blocked, missing an artifact, or ran on a different source head.
scenarios.expected_state: Qualification status is NOT_RUN or BLOCKED until exact-head evidence is available and checked.
forbidden_outcomes: Queued/in-progress interpreted as PASS.
Missing artifact interpreted as successful evidence.
Event SHA substituted silently for actual checkout HEAD.
required_evidence: Receipt artifact digest or explicit absence

scenarios.fault_injection: A required check is NOT_RUN or BLOCKED, and the operator console receives incomplete or stale evidence.
scenarios.expected_state: The interface preserves the exact status, gives the reason and safe next step, and makes no positive compliance claim.
forbidden_outcomes: NOT_RUN or BLOCKED rendered as PASS/green-compliant.
Status color is the only distinction without an accessible text label.
The operator cannot determine whether a scenario ran or what is needed next.
required_evidence: Injected state/status fixtures for PASS, FAIL, NOT_RUN, BLOCKED, and NOT_APPLICABLE
Rendered UI capture and accessible-name/status assertions
Blinded operator interpretation record with wrong-status counts and time-to-next-safe-action
scenarios.target: Proposed usability gate: at least 95% correct classification over a blinded scenario set and zero NOT_RUN-as-PASS misclassifications; measure cohort, task time, and confidence instead of assuming usability.

scenarios.fault_injection: An operator previews a high-impact action then cancels, closes the preview, or presents stale/target-mismatched authorization.
scenarios.expected_state: No mutation occurs until current, target-bound, explicit authorization is validated; cancellation leaves the target generation unchanged.
forbidden_outcomes: Preview implies that the action has been submitted or completed.
Cancelled operation continues in the background.
Stale consent or approval for another target/generation is reused.
required_evidence: UI preview/cancel interaction trace and keyboard-only run
Negative controls for stale authorization and target mismatch
scenarios.target: Proposed hard safety gate: zero mutations after cancellation or without current authorization; do not average any violation against usability or latency.
